item.description: AsyncResultBuilder class does not properly handle async generators and awaitable Result objects. Tests fail with "TypeError: object Result can't be used in 'await' expression" and "TypeError: 'async_generator' object is not an iterator". The implementation attempts to handle async generators but has flawed logic in the _send method.
item.contract: AsyncResultBuilder must properly handle async generators by detecting when a generator is actually an async generator and using __anext__() instead of send(). It must also support awaiting Result objects when they are yielded, properly unwrapping their values. The builder should return a Result type when awaited.

item.contract: AsyncOptionBuilder must properly handle async generators by detecting when a generator is actually an async generator and using __anext__() instead of send(). item.description: SeqBuilder class has incomplete implementation that doesn't properly handle async sequences and generators. The implementation doesn't account for async generators in the _send method, causing failures in tests that use async sequences.
item.contract: SeqBuilder must properly detect and handle async generators by using __anext__() instead of send(). It should also support proper async sequence operations and projections.

item.description: Result class does not implement proper async/await support. When Result objects are yielded in async contexts, they should be awaitable.
item.contract: Result class must implement __await__ method to make it awaitable when used in async contexts. This allows Result objects to be awaited in async generators and properly unwrapped.
